facts.value: The exported configuration storage is u8[8], not a complete ViCharaDesc. Its setter writes bytes 0, 1 and 3; opening-mode initialization separately fills bytes 4–6 with HSD_Randi(0x1B), and the three-Kirby scene receives the buffer address. Vi0501 entry interprets its argument as ViCharaDesc*, but participant setup consumes only three bytes beginning at spawn_count through an integer-erased pointer. Do not interpret those bytes as a numeric participant count or assume the trailing ViCharaDesc.unk field exists in this buffer.
facts.rationale: Adds useful cross-file producer and lifetime context to the already documented pointer-erased input, while preserving the eight-byte/twelve-byte representation mismatch.

evidence.why: Descriptor includes spawn_count at offset 4 and a trailing field at offset 8.
External code supplies the three byte values independently.
Three-Kirby scene receives the staging-buffer address.
Exactly three indexed byte reads configure the fixed Kirby slots.
Caller passes the field address through int.
